杀戮小队
原型：侦察，搜索与摧毁
特工
↘ 1 名恶角兽掠夺者铁角头领特工，装备有以
下一种选项：
• 腐化手枪；腐化链锯剑
• 等离子手枪；钝器
↘ 9 名恶角兽掠夺者特工，从以下列表中选择：
• 死亡丧钟
• 诡变者
• 疤面
• 血角
• 激兽师
• 撕裂者
• 萨满
• 毒角
• 破坏者
• 战士，装备有以下一种选项：
○ 自动手枪; 钝器
○ 自动手枪; 砍刀
除了战士特工以外，上述的每一名特工只能被纳
入您的杀戮小队一次。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGERS
KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPES: RECON, SEEK & DESTROY
OPERATIVES
↘ 1 FELLGOR RAVAGER IRONHORN operative
with one of the following options:
• Corrupted pistol; corrupted chainsword
• Plasma pistol; bludgeon
↘ 9 FELLGOR RAVAGER operatives selected
from the following list:
• DEATHKNELL
• FLUXBRAY
• GNARLSCAR
• GOREHORN
• HERD-GOAD
• MANGLER
• SHAMAN
• TOXHORN
• VANDAL
• WARRIOR with one of the following options:
○ Autopistol; bludgeon
○ Autopistol; cleaver
Other than WARRIOR operatives, your kill team
can only include each operative on this list once.

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
阵营规则
狂暴
恶角兽掠夺者能够将自己的痛苦转变为野蛮
的怒火，忽视自己受到的伤害并以野兽般的
凶性向敌人发起暴力突袭。
每当一名没有己方狂暴指示物的己方恶角兽掠夺
者特工将要在战斗中被残废时，不要将其残废，
并给予该特工一枚己方狂暴指示物。所有剩余的
攻击骰都将被舍弃（如果该特工正在进行近战或
者反击，那么您的攻击骰也会被舍弃)。如果特工
拥有隐匿命令，那么将其转变为拥有交战命令。
当一名己方恶角兽掠夺者特工拥有己方狂暴指
示物时：
• 特工只有在满足对页列有的条件时才会被残
废。
• 特工不能拥有隐匿命令。
• 特工处于受创状态。
• 特工不能执行拾取标识、独特行动（例如破坏
者的横扫攻击行动）或任务行动（操作舱门
除外)。
• 在判断对目标标识和杀戮区中特定区域的控制
权时，将特工的 APL 属性视为 1。本规则的
效果优先于任何属性修正。
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
FACTION RULE
FRENZY
Fellgor Ravagers channel their pain into an animalistic
frenzy, dismissing wounds and bursting with aggression.
Whenever a friendly FELLGOR RAVAGER
operative that doesn’t have one of your Frenzy tokens
would be incapacitated during the battle, it’s not
incapacitated and it gains one of your Frenzy tokens.
All remaining attack dice are discarded (including
yours if this operative is fighting or retaliating). If it has
a Conceal order, change it to Engage.
Whenever a friendly FELLGOR RAVAGER
operative has one of your Frenzy tokens:
• It’s only incapacitated as detailed overleaf.
• It cannot have a Conceal order.
• It’s injured.
• It cannot perform the Pick Up Marker, unique
(excluding Sweeping Blow, see VANDAL) or
mission actions (excluding Operate Hatch).
• For the purpose of determining control of
markers and areas of the killzone, treat its
APL stat as 1. This takes precedence over any
stat changes.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
一名拥有己方狂暴指示物的己方恶角兽掠夺者
特工在满足以下一个条件后被残废：
• 特工的激活或者反应结束。
• 在敌方特工对该特工进行近战或反击时，您的
对手使用一次关键成功出击。
• 在敌方特工对该特工进行近战或反击时，您的
对手第二次使用普通成功进行出击。请注意，
这可以是两次不同近战行动中进行的出击。
• 敌方特工对该特工进行射击并对其造成暴击
伤害。
• 一名敌方特工对它射击，并且有两枚或更多攻
击骰造成了普通伤害。
• 战斗结束（在任意于战斗结束时结算的胜利规
则前结算)。
在处理获得 VP 的情况时（如击杀行动）和牵涉
到特工残废的阵营规则时（如执政官之手的
“痛苦之力”、混沌教派的“变异”等），您
的对手将获得己方狂暴指示物的恶角兽掠夺者
特工视为已被残废（而不是残废的通常规则）。
cards.text_en:
A friendly FELLGOR RAVAGER operative that has
one of your Frenzy tokens is incapacitated when
one of the following is met:
• Its activation or counteraction ends.
• An enemy operative is fighting against or
retaliating against it and your opponent strikes
with a critical success.
• An enemy operative is fighting against or
retaliating against it and your opponent strikes
it for a second time with a normal success.
Note this can be strikes from two different
Fight actions.
• An enemy operative is shooting it and Critical
Dmg is inflicted on it.
• An enemy operative is shooting it and Normal
Dmg from two or more attack dice is inflicted
on it.
• The battle ends (resolve this before any victory
conditions that resolve at the end of the battle).
Your opponent treats a FELLGOR RAVAGER
operative as being incapacitated (instead of when
it would be incapacitated normally) when it gains
one of your Frenzy tokens for the purposes of
scoring VPs (e.g. kill op) and faction rules that
require it to be incapacitated (e.g. HAND OF
THE ARCHON Power From Pain, CHAOS CULT
Mutation, etc.).

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
战略计谋
暴躁脾气
野兽人被一种原始的野蛮本能所驱使，持续
不停地向敌人发起狂乱的攻击。
每当一名己方恶角兽掠夺者特工进行近战或反
击时，在您掷攻击骰后，您可以使用本规则。若
使用，您必须重掷自己的所有攻击骰（您不能选
择只重掷其中一些骰子)。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
STRATEGY PLOY
VIOLENT TEMPERAMENT
Fellgor Beastmen are driven by primal savagery, striking
at their foes with frenzied blow after frenzied blow.
Whenever a friendly FELLGOR RAVAGER
operative is fighting or retaliating, after rolling
your attack dice, you can use this rule. If you
do, you must re-roll all of your attack dice (you
cannot only re-roll some).

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
战略计谋
埋伏
恶角兽掠夺者们会利用黑暗所提供的掩护来
对敌人发起奇袭并展开屠杀。
每当一名己方恶角兽掠夺者特工被激活时，如
果它的命令从隐匿转为交战，那么特工在那次激
活中进行埋伏。每当一名进行埋伏的己方恶角兽
掠夺者特工进行近战时，您可以将自己的一次
普通成功作为关键成功进行保留。请注意，拥有
己方狂暴指示物的特工不能进行埋伏。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
STRATEGY PLOY
AMBUSH
Fellgor Ravagers utilise cover and darkness to strike
from the shadows and butcher the enemy.
Whenever a friendly FELLGOR RAVAGER
operative is activated, if its order is changed
from Conceal to Engage, it’s ambushing for
that activation. Whenever a friendly FELLGOR
RAVAGER operative that’s ambushing is fighting,
you can retain one of your normal successes
as a critical success instead. Note that an
operative that has one of your Frenzy tokens
cannot ambush.

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
战略计谋
叠加火力
虽然缺乏精度，但恶角兽掠夺者一同倾泻的
火力依靠着纯粹的数量也将变得极为致命。
每当一名己方恶角兽掠夺者特工对一名在转折
点中被另一名己方恶角兽掠夺者特工射击过的
敌方特工进行射击时，进行射击的己方特工的
远程武器拥有“无休”武器规则；如果那名敌
方特工在转折点中被超过一名其他己方恶角兽
掠夺者特工射击，则进行射击的己方特工的远
程武器拥有“毫不留情”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
STRATEGY PLOY
PELTING FIREPOWER
Though it may lack accuracy, the combined firepower
of a group of Fellgor Ravagers is rendered lethal by
its volume.
Whenever a friendly FELLGOR RAVAGER
operative is shooting an enemy operative that’s
been shot by another friendly FELLGOR
RAVAGER operative during this turning point,
that first friendly operative’s ranged weapons
have the Ceaseless weapon rule; if the enemy
operative has been shot by more than one other
friendly FELLGOR RAVAGER operative during
this turning point, that first friendly operative’s
ranged weapons have the Relentless weapon
rule instead.

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
战略计谋
冲动决心
恶角兽掠夺者想要杀死敌人的坚定决心使他
们能够抵御敌人的射击。
每当一名敌方特工对一名处于待机的己方恶角兽
掠夺者特工进行射击时，如果您不能保留任何
掩护豁免，那么您可以在不掷骰的情况下将一枚
防御骰作为普通成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
STRATEGY PLOY
RECKLESS DETERMINATION
Such is their determination to slaughter the enemy
that the Fellgor Ravagers will shrug off volleys of
incoming fire.
Whenever an enemy operative is shooting
an expended friendly FELLGOR RAVAGER
operative, if you cannot retain any cover saves,
you can retain one of your defence dice as a
normal success without rolling it.

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
交战计谋
无息毁灭
随着每一次击杀，恶角兽掠夺者们的怒火就会
提升至新的高度并进一步向敌人发起追击。
在一名己方恶角兽掠夺者特工执行了近战行动
后，如果其控制范围内不存在任何敌方特工，那
么您可以使用本交战计谋。那名己方特工可以立
即执行一次无消耗的冲锋行动（就算特工在激活
期间已经执行过了冲锋行动)，但是在那次行动
期间不能移动超过 3"。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
RUTHLESS RAMPAGE
With each kill they make, so are the Fellgor Ravagers
driven to new heights of fury with which to chase down
their foes.
Use this firefight ploy after a friendly FELLGOR
RAVAGER operative performs the Fight
action, if it's no longer within control range of
enemy operatives. That friendly operative can
immediately perform a free Charge action (even
if it’s already performed the Charge action during
that activation), but cannot move more than 3"
during that action.

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
交战计谋
狂乱暴怒
在恶角兽掠夺者被野性怒火吞噬的时候，他
们能够以惊人的速度进行移动。
在一名己方恶角兽掠夺者特工被激活时使用本
交战计谋。直到那名特工的激活结束前，其移动
属性增加 1"。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
WILD RAGE
When Fellgor Ravagers find themselves overcome by
bestial rage, they are able to move with terrifying speed.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly FELLGOR
RAVAGER operative is activated. Until the
end of that operative’s activation, add 1" to its
Move stat.

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
交战计谋
野性狂怒
在被激怒之后，恶角兽掠夺者会以可怕的力
量与残暴的手段进行攻击。
在一名己方恶角兽掠夺者特工进行近战或反击
时，如果您使用了一次关键成功进行出击，那么
您可以使用本交战计谋。那次出击将造成额外 1
点伤害。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ANIMALISTIC FURY
When whipped into a frenzy, Fellgor Ravagers strike with
terrifying strength and brutality.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly FELLGOR
RAVAGER operative is fighting or retaliating
and you strike with a critical success. Inflict 1
additional damage with that strike.

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
交战计谋
鲜血感知
鲜血的流淌会使恶角兽掠夺者陷入到一种传
染性的战斗狂怒中。
在一名己方恶角兽掠夺者特工的激活中，当它
将其控制范围内的敌方特工残废时使用本交战计
谋。选择另一名位于被残废敌方特工 3" 内且对
该特工可见的己方恶角兽掠夺者特工。在第一
名特工进入待机后，您可以在对手之前将那另一
名己方特工激活。在另一名己方特工激活后，您
的对手可以照常激活特工。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
BLOODSENSE
As the blood flows, a contagious battle-frenzy
overcomes the Fellgor Ravagers.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly FELLGOR
RAVAGER operative’s activation, when it
incapacitates an enemy operative within its
control range. Select one other ready friendly
FELLGOR RAVAGER operative that’s visible
to and within 3" of the incapacitated enemy
operative. When that first friendly operative is
expended, you can activate that other friendly
operative before your opponent activates. When
that other operative is expended, your opponent
then activates as normal.

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
阵营装备
黄铜饰品
黄铜蹄铁、角尖和焊接上的尖刺能够使恶角
兽掠夺者变得更加渴望暴力，同时也为他们
提供了额外的武器。
每场战斗限一次，您可以消耗 0CP 来使用“野
性狂怒”和“狂乱暴怒”交战计谋各一次。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
BRASS ADORNMENTS
Brass-plated hooves, horn caps or welded spikes incite
within the Fellgor Ravagers an even greater lust for
violence, and provide them with additional weapons
with which to mete it out.
Once per battle, you can use the Animalistic Fury
and Wild Rage firefight ploys for 0CP each.

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
阵营装备
血腥印记
这些由萨满所造成的伤口会在战斗期间持续
不停地流血，鲜血的味道能够强化野兽人的
战斗能力。
每个转折点限一次，在一名己方恶角兽掠夺者
特工进行近战或反击时，您可以使用本规则。若
使用，对那名己方特工造成 1 点伤害，并重掷一
枚自己的攻击骰。如果掷骰结果为失败，那么对
那个己方特工造成额外 1 点伤害。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
GORE MARKS
Inflicted upon a Fellgor Ravager by their Shamans, these
wounds continue to bleed as the battle unfolds, the
stench of fresh blood empowering the Beastmen.
Once per turning point, when a friendly FELLGOR
RAVAGER operative is fighting or retaliating,
you can use this rule. If you do, inflict 1 damage
on that friendly operative and re-roll one of
your attack dice. If the result is a fail, inflict 1
additional damage on that friendly operative.

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
阵营装备
混沌魔符
这些徽记蕴藏着亚空间的能量，并且受到萨
满的祝福，它们能够为黑暗诸神的虔诚信徒
提供庇护。
每个转折点限一次，在一名特工对己方恶角兽掠
夺者特工进行射击时，您可以在掷防御骰步骤
开始时使用本规则。若使用，那么直到那次流程
结束前，“穿刺”武器规则的 x 数值被减弱 1 点
（若有)。请注意，这意味着“穿刺 1”武器规则
将被无视。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CHAOS SIGIL
Imbued with warp energies and blessed by a Shaman,
this icon offers protection to a dedicated worshipper of
the Dark Gods.
Once per turning point, when an operative is
shooting a friendly FELLGOR RAVAGER
operative, at the start of the Roll Defence Dice
step, you can use this rule. If you do, worsen the x
of the Piercing weapon rule by 1 (if any) until the
end of that sequence. Note that Piercing 1 would
therefore be ignored.

cards.text:
恶角兽掠夺者
阵营装备
战争涂纹
仪式性的战争涂纹在战斗之前被画在了恶角
兽掠夺者的身上，使他们能够无视自己的伤
势并不顾一切地冲入战斗之中。
您可以忽略任何己方恶角兽掠夺者特工因受创
而导致的对移动属性的修正。
cards.text_en:
FELLGOR RAVAGER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
WAR PAINT
Applied in ritual fashion prior to battle, war paint
emboldens the Fellgor Ravagers to shrug off their
wounds and hurl themselves into the fight.
You can ignore any changes to the Move stat of
friendly FELLGOR RAVAGER operatives from
being injured.
